[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Harrin Tarn''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who commanded a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of troops on a layover on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Tarn was authorized to allow his troops some rest and recuperation by attending a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] bazaar on the [[Circle Route]]. Tarn and his troops were forced to fight the [[Krayt Draggers]], a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] who tried to shoot up the trade camp.
